description: Per-profile home/library section customization: overrides, reset, the resolved settings list, and the custom-sections flag.

not_applicable.sorting: Overrides carry their own position field; the list is returned in store order.
not_applicable.error: Only the profile/auth refusals apply; the read has no validation branch.
not_applicable.raw_protocol: Plain JSON request/response; no ranges, redirects, multipart, or upgrades.

scenarios.description: Lists the profile's section overrides for the home scope: 200 JSON.
With nothing saved the list is an empty array, never null.
scope defaults to home; an explicit library scope with library_id filters to that library.
The wrapper always has exactly overrides.
Without X-Profile-Id the RequireProfile middleware answers 400 bad_request (not 401/403).
scenarios.notes: Missing profile header is a 400, the same status as a malformed body; flagged for the section PR.

scenarios.description: A declared profile that does not belong to the account is 404 not_found from viewer access.

A member bearer declaring a profile owned by another account (the admin's primary) is 404 not_found from viewer access: the profile lookup is scoped to the bearer's account, so a foreign profile is indistinguishable from an unknown one.
scenarios.notes: Cross-account probe. The 404 (not 403) is the current scoped-lookup behavior; recorded as-is.

scenarios.description: Without a bearer the auth middleware refuses the request before the handler runs.

scenarios.description: Saving overrides answers 204.
A saved override is returned by the next GET with the same section_id, hidden flag, and position.
scenarios.notes: The executor runs rows independently, so the GET-after-PUT round trip lives in the section PR's handler test.

scenarios.description: A non-admin adding a custom (admin-only recipe) section while the server setting is off is 403 custom_disabled.

body.value: this server does not allow profiles to build custom sections

scenarios.description: With sections.allow_profile_custom_sections on, the same request is accepted.
An admin bypasses the custom-section gate.
An unregistered section_type on a user-added override is 400 unknown_recipe.
A recipe config that fails validation is 400 invalid_config.

body.value: admin_curated_list: item_ids must not be empty

With no admin sections seeded the list is empty (never null).
